entries.summary: Sections that open and close, built from data -- a record's groups, a settings panel, an FAQ -- or from <details> in the markup, drawn as the class accordion: the same sizes on the control ladder, appearances, marker and single section. single keeps one open; the headers are buttons with the WAI-ARIA accordion keyboard.
entries.title: Accordion

entries.summary: Persistent inline notice with semantic roles, optional actions and dismiss behavior.
entries.title: Alert

entries.summary: A full-width bar above a page or admin header for the conditions that need action now: error, warning, info. One bar for all of them, coloured by the most serious; several are paged «‹ 1 of N ›» and listed under the bar with «All N». Warning closes for a day, info for good, error only minimizes to a strip. It stores nothing: the host keeps what was closed.
entries.title: Alert bar

entries.summary: Shows a person or organisation as a photo or initials, with an optional availability or verification mark. The default and label templates render a native button whose aria-label names its action; the card template is static and adds a title, description and meta line.
entries.title: Avatar

entries.summary: Ready combinations of avatars: a person with a source, a stacked group with a remainder, an avatar with two lines of label, and a profile avatar with a verified badge. Drawn from sf-avatar's parts; for a single avatar with a name or a card use sf-avatar.
entries.title: Avatars

entries.summary: A short non-interactive label for a status, a run's state, a category, a version or a count beside an object, drawn in a size, appearance and colour role or status. It adds no keyboard or pointer behaviour.
entries.title: Badges

entries.summary: Shows the current page's place in a hierarchy as a trail of native links built from items, the items attribute or sf-breadcrumbs-item children. A long trail collapses its middle into an ellipsis button (max-items, default 4) that expands in place.
entries.title: Breadcrumbs

entries.summary: A native button with Framework presentation: size, appearance, colour role or status, optional start and end icons, height and radius. loading sets aria-busy and disables it against repeated activation.
entries.title: Buttons

entries.summary: The close button of the SIMAI Framework: a real button (focus, Enter and Space, the name «Закрыть» by default) drawing the cross with a 2px line, in three looks -- ghost, plain and media. Inside a native button it stays the decorative cross it was before 1.2.0.
entries.title: Close

entries.summary: Copies a value or a target's text, confirms with a check and a polite announcement, and selects the text for Ctrl+C when the browser refuses the clipboard.
entries.title: Copy button

entries.summary: Native icon-only action with token geometry, accessible naming and shared loading semantics.
entries.title: Icon Buttons

entries.summary: A native checkbox with a label, Framework presentation and checked, indeterminate and disabled states kept in step between the host attributes and the inner input.
entries.title: Checkbox

entries.summary: A question put to a person in place -- a delete asked in its row, a member removed, a view reset: what will happen, two answers, a pending state while the answer is applied, the outcome, and an optional time it runs out. Applies nothing; a press is an event.
entries.title: Confirmation

entries.summary: A prepared change put to a person: each value as it was and as it will be, two answers of equal weight, until when it can be answered, and then only the outcome. Applies nothing; a press is an event.
entries.title: Change confirmation

entries.summary: The page's table of contents («Оглавление»): the sections of the page as in-page links, the current one marked while the page scrolls. Four views from one list -- a side column, a compact button with the reading progress, strokes at the edge, a sticky row of anchor tabs -- and auto, the column on a wide screen and the compact button on a narrow one. It collects the headings itself or takes the items a server printed, and works as plain links without the script.
entries.title: Contents

entries.summary: Workspace side panel that keeps the page usable: docked column or modeless panel. Modal side panels belong to sf-modal; the modal Drawer mode is deprecated.
entries.title: Drawer

entries.summary: Accessible single or multiple selection control with searchable options and optional portal projection.
entries.title: Dropdown

entries.summary: Edits a content.heading or content.paragraph in place on the canvas -- strong, em, code, links and the inline component atoms -- and gives the host the normalised content model, never HTML.
entries.title: Inline editor

entries.summary: The editor's layer over a rendered Composition Document: hover and selection frames, a toolbar of the node's actions, insertion places, moves by pointer and keyboard and a structure tree; the canvas is never changed and the host performs every change.
entries.title: Composition overlay

entries.summary: What a list, a panel or a page says when it has nothing to show: no data, nothing found, no access or an error, with an icon, a real heading, a sentence and actions.
entries.title: Empty state

entries.summary: Native file download or application-owned file preparation action.
entries.title: Download File

entries.summary: Accessible Smart projection of the ordinary File Preview row.
entries.title: File Preview

entries.summary: A drop area that opens the platform file dialog or takes dropped files, filtered by accept, and lists each file with its upload progress, an error with a retry, and removal. The host uploads; the component shows the state the host sets.
entries.title: File Upload

entries.summary: An ordered media collection shown in an inline Slider, with an optional Modal lightbox holding a second Slider. The gallery owns the one-based current slide and keeps both views on it.
entries.title: Gallery

entries.summary: The head of an admin page: path, heading, count, favourite star, install mark and main action. Replaces the admin top bar together with sf-admin-menu.
entries.title: Page header

entries.summary: The top bar of a SIMAI site: brand, navigation, actions and tools in one row on the container's width, collapsing below a Framework breakpoint into a menu button that opens the navigation and actions as a side panel in the shared layer stack. Every SIMAI site uses it: the effects catalogue, Docara documentation sites and the simai.io hub.
entries.title: Site header

entries.summary: A «?» beside a label that opens a short explanation on a press -- a toggletip -- announced politely, closed by Escape, a second press or a click outside.
entries.title: Help mark

entries.summary: Semantic Material Symbol wrapper with exact Loader tracking, accessible decorative or informative modes and token-owned geometry.
entries.title: Icons

entries.summary: Loads a part of the page from an address: a skeleton while it loads, the server's HTML in its place when it arrives (the Loader starts the components in it), an error with Retry when it does not. load="view" waits until the part nears the viewport.
entries.title: Include

entries.summary: A native single-line form control with Framework presentation, validation messaging and optional mask integration.
entries.title: Text fields

entries.summary: A form field that picks one option, or several, from cards in three layouts: list (one frame of rows, delivery and payment), tile (plans, modules) and picture (templates with an image). Each card has a name, a badge, a description, a price and term, and the real radio or checkbox on its name line. One option is a radio group the arrow keys move through; several are checkboxes. A chosen card has a 2 px primary edge over the lowest primary fill; invalid cards an error edge and a message under them.
entries.title: Choice

entries.summary: A one-time code -- from a message, an authenticator, an email -- as a form field with its own value, paste and errors, drawn as the class verification: one native input holds the code (autocomplete one-time-code, so autofill and WebOTP fill it whole) and the cells picture it. Typing fills the next cell, Backspace steps back and clears, a pasted code fills every cell, and each cell is announced by its place.
entries.title: Code input

entries.summary: A colour control: a swatch that opens the platform picker, the colours a product already has as presets, and a way back to an inherited colour. Built as a general part because a colour is set in a theme, in a site look, on a label and on a chart series, not only on a record.
entries.title: Color

entries.summary: A telephone field with a country picker: a button opens a searchable listbox of countries, and the chosen country sets the dial code, flag and, optionally, the input mask of the native tel input.
entries.title: Country Code

entries.summary: Accessible date, date-and-time, time and date-range picker with popup and inline presentation, calendar and time navigation and host-owned values.
entries.title: Datepicker

entries.summary: A form field for one image: a thumbnail with the file name and size, «Заменить…» and «Убрать», a file dropped anywhere on it replaces the image; label, help, error, required, disabled and read-only as every field has them. It raises the chosen File; the host uploads it.
entries.title: Image field

entries.summary: A form field that picks people or objects from a search the host answers: type, see rows with a picture, a name and a caption, choose one or several. Chosen items are removable chips; the list says when it waits for more letters, searches, finds nothing, is unavailable or failed, with a retry.
entries.title: Lookup

entries.summary: A number field with «−» and «+»: a WAI-ARIA spinbutton with bounds, a step and digits, strict typing in the page's language, ArrowUp/ArrowDown, PageUp/PageDown and Home/End, a held stepper repeats; label, help, error, required, disabled, read-only, the three field sizes and the inherited value as every field has them.
entries.title: Quantity

entries.summary: A form field for formatted text: paragraphs, headings 2 to 4, bold, italic, links, bulleted and numbered lists and quotes, with a toolbar, undo and redo. Its value is HTML of that subset and nothing else: the value it is given, every paste and drop and every edit are cleaned to it.
entries.title: Rich text

entries.summary: A native multiline form control with Framework presentation, validation messaging and safe vertical resizing.
entries.title: Text area

entries.summary: The site's language picker. Two or three languages are a segmented switch, all in sight, one press; four to seven an icon button («translate») with a menu, each row the name in itself and in English; eight and more the same menu with search by either name or the code. One language draws nothing. A choice is a cancellable change; then the element follows the language's href or applies the language to the page (SF.language.use, lang and dir on <html>).
entries.title: Language

entries.summary: A list a person acts on -- conversations, letters, templates, files, members, versions: rows from data drawn as sf-list-item, grouped by day or by key, one Tab stop, the open row, row actions in one shared menu, rename in place, the next page at the end, an empty state. Fetches nothing; every request is an event.
entries.title: List

entries.summary: The problems that need a person: a heading with their count, then each problem with its status, title, a line of text and one action (a link or a button), the most serious first. With no problems it draws nothing, or one quiet line; it never takes an empty card.
entries.title: Needs attention

entries.summary: A description list: facts as label and value rows (a site summary, server facts, a record's header, a job's parameters, licence details). The labels stand in a column of their own and go over their values on a phone; a value can be monospace, a link, copied with a button, carry a status and a hint; a long value wraps or is cut with the whole of it on demand; an empty one shows «—».
entries.title: Description list

entries.summary: A feed: a scrolling column of entries read from the newest at the end -- a conversation, comments, an activity history, an audit log. Keeps the reading place while history is added above, follows the end only when the reader is there, «to the latest», asks once for earlier history, announces what is new once, draws a growing entry in place. The host draws each entry.
entries.title: Feed

entries.summary: A row: an option sf-dropdown captures, or the general list row -- a supporting line, a row a person acts on, an item of an sf-sortable list, a pinned row.
entries.title: List item

entries.summary: An activity timeline: events on a vertical line, each with its status marker (a dot or an icon), title, time, actor and text, grouped by day («Сегодня», «Вчера», the date), the time relative with the exact moment on hover, a «Показать ещё» button and a quiet line when there are none. Normal or compact density, sizes 1/2, 1 and 2.
entries.title: Timeline

entries.summary: Site navigation built from data -- nested sections, the current page, groups that open and close -- or from a nested list of links in the markup, drawn as the class menu: a column whose branches open in place, or a row whose branches open as panels placed by SF.Position, which becomes a button opening the same links when it does not fit. The WAI-ARIA disclosure navigation pattern, not an application menu.
entries.title: Menu

entries.summary: The Framework's action menu and its settings panel: data entries with icon, caption, value, shortcut, check, submenu, separator and heading, and the value rows a setting needs (switch, range, choice, a group of rows or tiles) with one change event and the set-value, set-all, reset and show actions, opened by openFor() into the top layer, anchored, with keyboard, typeahead and focus return. A host may still render its own items and own the lifecycle.
entries.title: Context Menu

entries.summary: A dialog window over the page in the shared modal stack: centered or at a side, top or bottom edge, with header, content and footer slots, focus trap, scroll lock and focus return. It can also be minimized, load its content by Ajax or into an iframe, or render inline in the page flow.
entries.title: Modal

entries.summary: Navigation to the neighbouring page or step by meaning: the previous and the next documentation page as two cards or one row of links, a wizard's Back and Next with its step track, a course's lesson dots and next lesson, or a record counter. Not list paging: sf-pagination keeps 1, 2, 3 ….
entries.title: Pager

entries.summary: Source-driven navigation for a collection split into numbered pages.
entries.title: Pagination

entries.summary: A surface anchored to a control the consumer supplies, with its own open state, dismissal and returned focus. Built as a general part because the Framework had the surface and not the behaviour: two composites wrote it by hand within a week, the second copying the first.
entries.title: Popover

entries.summary: One way to choose, make, rename, remove and reset a profile: a field-like button naming the profile in use, and a panel where every act happens inline. The profiles and the rights are the host's; the component says what was asked.
entries.title: Profile picker

entries.summary: Continuous determinate progress with normalized value, accessible range semantics and explicit semantic tone.
entries.title: Progress Bar

entries.summary: A value from 0 to 100, or an unknown one, drawn as a ring on the control ladder, with the percentage or a picture in the middle.
entries.title: Progress Ring

entries.summary: A long job as a person sees it: its steps with states (waiting, running, done, failed, skipped) and the time of each, a collapsible output pane (monospace, an append action, following the newest line only while the reader is at the end, copy and download), the result (success, or failure with its reason) and the actions Cancel, Retry and Hide. The host drives it; it polls nothing.
entries.title: Progress

entries.summary: Segmented determinate progress with exact accessible value, explicit semantic tone and ten visual steps.
entries.title: Progress Scale

entries.summary: One radio option: a native radio input with a label, description and help text. Radios with the same name form a group in which checking one unchecks the others.
entries.title: Radio buttons

entries.summary: Navigation surface that pairs a real destination with a compact reference.
entries.title: Reference Link

entries.summary: A handle on a panel's edge that changes the panel's width by a drag, the keyboard or a double click back to the default, within limits; optionally remembered in the browser.
entries.title: Resizer

entries.summary: Site search in a window: a large rounded field and a separate results card under it over the shared scrim, opened by a trigger or a key (Command/Control+K, /), a full-screen sheet on a phone. The panel asks a host through simai.search-port and draws what the host announces it can answer: grouped results, scopes, recent and popular queries, commands, a correction and a preview beside the list. Each block is also a setting, so the capability says what is possible and the setting says what is wanted. A page with no host of its own gets the built-in ones: a static JSON index (index) or a provider function.
entries.title: Site search

entries.summary: A controlled single-selection group built from SF5 buttons.
entries.title: Segmented control

entries.summary: Compact settings: a few settings a person changes on the spot, as data, each holding its own value, drawn by sf-menu-context in one of three looks -- drill (the value under the name, the options in the same panel), rows (the control at the row's end) or tiles (the switches used most as tiles on top). With a trigger it opens over the page; without one it stands in the page's flow. A change is asked first (cancellable), then written and reported; remember keeps the values for the person.
entries.title: Settings

entries.summary: Decorative loading placeholder that reserves source-backed content geometry with semantic tokens and reduced-motion support.
entries.title: Skeleton

entries.summary: A row of slides moved by arrows, dots, swipe or keys, built on the shared Swiper adapter; with linked thumbnails a second slider picks the slide.
entries.title: Slider

entries.summary: A slider for one number or a range of two on a track: drag, click or keys move a handle by step, the fill shows the chosen part, and the value can be shown as text or a tooltip on each handle.
entries.title: Range Slider

entries.summary: A list whose items move by pointer, touch and keyboard, between lists of a group and onto registered drop targets; it asks the host to move and never moves the host's DOM or data.
entries.title: Drag and drop

entries.summary: Indeterminate waiting indicator in one of four looks on the size ladder (arc, breathing, comet, dots), following the page's data-sf-spinner, with optional polite status announcement and Framework-owned motion.
entries.title: Spinner

entries.summary: A row of labelled step buttons, separated by an icon, for a multi-step process: marks the current, completed, skipped, running and error steps and moves to an enabled step when it is pressed.
entries.title: Steps

entries.summary: An on/off control for a setting that applies at once: a native checkbox with role="switch", a track and a moving thumb, with a label, description and help text.
entries.title: Switch

entries.summary: A tab list that shows one local panel at a time, with text or icon tabs given as attributes, slots or data, roving keyboard focus and linked tab panels.
entries.title: Tabs

entries.summary: Compact static, selectable and removable labels with one explicit interaction owner.
entries.title: Tags

entries.summary: A theme from one colour: the main colour, the generator's own hue and chroma, a preview of the eight palettes and a way back to SIMAI Framework's colour; it stores nothing and changes the page only with apply.
entries.title: Theme generator

entries.summary: A metric tile: a label, a value with its unit, the change against a previous period said in words and by an arrow, a limit as a meter with thresholds, a status with a short hint, a slot for a chart, a skeleton while it loads, and the whole tile as one link or button. Tiles stand in a row that wraps (sf-tile-metric-grid).
entries.title: Metric tile

entries.summary: Transient overlay feedback with semantic roles, optional action, pause-safe lifetime and dismiss behavior.
entries.title: Toast

entries.summary: Tooltip surface that can join the ordinary data-tooltip trigger composition.
entries.title: Tooltip

entries.summary: A tree of entries: folders that open, files and links; one Tab stop walked with the arrows, optional selection, drops of records and files on an entry. Thousands of entries: keyed rows, a window over more than 300.
entries.title: Tree

entries.summary: A node of a tree: a folder that opens a group of nodes, or a file or link. Inside sf-tree it is read once as data and the tree draws its row; alone it draws itself.
entries.title: Tree item

entries.summary: The universal step-by-step wizard: a frame of sf-wizard-step children with the progress on top (a row up to 7 steps, «Шаг 4 из 12» and a bar above, a column inside the frame as an option, the current step and a bar on a phone), the step's title, «why» and body, and one footer: Back, Skip, one primary action. Step types info, form, action, review, result; states not started, done, skipped, running, error; navigation linear, free or visited; places inline, modal and pages (the server's page per step, its form posting). Continue later, a question before closing with unsaved input, and one value of all answers.
entries.title: Wizard

entries.summary: One step of sf-wizard: its key, label, title, «why», type, optional, address in place pages, primary label and result line as attributes, its state as a value, and its body -- a form, a picture, a plan of changes -- as its children, which stay where the page put them.
entries.title: Wizard step
